trap-nonspeakable.notes: Separate (non-trap) findings, all verified: (1) the algebra is CORRECT — recomputed (sigma+d)(alpha' sigma + beta') = (alpha'(h+d)+beta') sigma + (alpha'+beta' d) 1 using sigma^2 = h sigma + 1, matching the stated recursion, and the base case 1 = 0*sigma + 1*1 matches (0,1); the closed form alpha = (E1-E2)/(q+q^{-1}) also checks, since alpha q + beta = E1 and -alpha q^{-1} + beta = E2 subtract to alpha(q+q^{-1}) = E1-E2. (2) "since $\sigma_i$ annihilates $(x-q)(x+q^{-1})$" is inverted — the polynomial annihilates the generator; sigma_i is a ROOT of it. Proposed fix: "since $(x-q)(x+q^{-1})$ annihilates $\sigma_i$". (3) "used for canonical speed" reads as the documented canonical-for-numerical token substitution ("used for numerical speed"); note the tree has a single squashed commit so git provenance could not confirm it.
